questions.question: Which player is the only one in this database's history to score 200+ runs AND take 3+ wickets in the same match?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade is the sole member of the 200-run/3-wicket club, achieving it in a single match against Kei on 10 February 2018 (212 runs, 3 for 26).

questions.question: At which ground did Sibabalwe Takatshana record their career-best bowling figures (3-44, List A)?
